mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an easing monetary policy cycle that reduces discount rates on equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 5.6% in a 3-month period signals labor market tightening, leading to reduced corporate investment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or IC > 0.05 over the 20-day horizon in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) above their 3-month moving averages signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: 3-month moving average crossover of GDPC1 and INDPRO
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 12-month rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive in expansionary periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 1.5 million in a post-recession labor market expansion regime predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate optimism rises.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite high PAYEMS in the regime, or IC < 0.1 over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates below 2% and rising GDP growth (GDPC1) creates a favorable monetary and demand environment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% and GDPC1 increases > 3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies meet the trigger, or IC < 0.03 over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: An inflation surge above 2% in CPIAUCSL indicates aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain positive despite high inflation, or IC > 0.2 over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial utilization (HOUST) above 1.5K combined with declining industrial output (RSAFS) signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above 1.5K and RSAFS falls below 500M
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain positive despite the shock indicators, or IC < 0.05 over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 3-month average predicts stronger supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO is rising, or IC < 0.03 over the 20-day window.
